scope.market_definition: The smartphone market encompasses the design, manufacturing, and distribution of mobile devices that integrate computing capabilities with telecommunication functions. Key participants include manufacturers, component suppliers, software developers, and retailers, operating on a global scale.

value_chain_layers.description: This layer involves the production of smartphones, including assembly and integration of components.
This layer includes the development of operating systems and applications for smartphones.
This layer covers the channels through which smartphones are sold to consumers.

# About BLU Products

BLU Products is a privately owned American company founded in 2009. We have sold over 70 million
devices to date, making it one of the fastest-growing reputable brands in the mobile industry.

Fastest Growing American Mobile Company

## Design.
## Quality. Price.

We pride ourselves in consistently providing users with reliable smartphones at an affordable price
without sacrificing stylish design and superior quality. As a result, we have continued to grow and
expand, cultivating a passionate fanbase with followers worldwide.

## From Miami,
## with Love

We stay true to our roots by tapping into the vibrant culture of our hometown, Miami, FL. Like our
city, we integrate multicultural influences and fashion-forward detailing into our products. This
fresh perspective allows BLU to develop inexpensive, innovative mobile devices. With phones that fit
any budget, our high-quality standards and fashionable designs suit anyone seeking more value
for their money.

Our rapid growth has propelled BLU phones internationally, achieving global success. We have secured
thousands of dealer agents, MVNOs, and large retailers throughout the United States, the Caribbean,
Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

## Certified
## Minority-Owned Business

BLU Products is proud to be a certified Minority-Owned Business. We dedicate ourselves to serving
our community and leading by example to influence positive change. We recognize the benefits of
diversity in the workplace and extend those values to our customers. Businesses that partner with
BLU Products are supporting supplier diversity and inclusion.

In addition, EcoVadis has awarded BLU a Bronze Medal in recognition of our high environmental,
social, and ethical business standards. We've implemented innovative practices for efficient supply
chains and sustainable procurement. At BLU, we always factor local and global impacts into our
decision making, consistently prioritizing sustainability on all fronts.

[National Minority Supplier Development Council]

We take pride in our culture and apply it to everything we do.

contrast ratios, while LTPO technology enables variable refresh rates from 1Hz to 120Hz or even

standard even in mid-range devices, offering significantly faster download speeds and lower latency.

ensures stable connections with wireless accessories. NFC enables contactless payments, and
satellite connectivity is emerging as a safety feature in remote areas.

# UP DigiShakti Portal - Student Login, Registration & E-KYC

The Uttar Pradesh government has launched the UP DigiShakti Portal to facilitate the distribution of
tablets and smartphones to eligible students in the state. Through this portal, students can
complete their e-KYC verification, check their eligibility status, and access information about
tablet/smartphone distribution.

This portal streamlines the verification process through MeriPehchaan e-KYC and ensures eligible
students receive their devices efficiently.

any fake/malicious websites.

Sailfish OS is a Linux-based European alternative to dominating mobile operating systems, and the
only mobile OS offering an exclusive licensing model for local implementations.

On the market since 2013 Sailfish OS is the privacy respecting choice for mobile solutions. With
Sailfish OS you can also run Android™ apps with our dedicated AppSupport solution.

Sailfish OS is managed and developed by Finnish company [Jolla][9].

[Try and buy now!][10]

##### Business & partnership inquiries: [partners@jolla.com][11]


# Reliable corporate platform

Sailfish OS is a secure and privacy respecting mobile operating system optimized to run on
smartphones and tablets, and also easily adaptable to all kinds of embedded devices and use cases.
With the operating system enablers Sailfish OS can be adapted to support different ecosystem
projects, be it private corporate solutions or public sector governmental deployments.

[Read more ›][12]

# Security

Sailfish OS has a host of modern security functionalities developed specifically for corporate and
governmental environments. In Sailfish OS user data is fully encrypted and apps are protected by
Firejail sandboxing. Connectivity is behind a firewall and protected with in-built support for VPNs,
and automatic backups always secure your data. Core OS services are sandboxed using systemd, and the
whole system can be managed on the OS level with the full-scale MDM capability.

[Read more >][13]

# Customize to your needs

Adaptability is in the core of Sailfish OS. It can be adapted to different corporate and

Sailfish OS has been built ground-up to scale to different form factors and input styles. Sub-pixel

Furthermore, fully customizable preloaded content helps you tailor the OS to your needs: wallpapers,

## Dedicated device mode

Sailfish OS is smart at heart, but also a great companion for single-purpose devices designed to
handle a few functions really well.

Focus on creating a great product experience, and let Sailfish OS worry about the nitty-gritty
technical details like connectivity, security, user management, over-the-air updates, and other OS
services.

# World-class mobile device management for corporations

Mobile device management (MDM) support in Sailfish OS is designed to meet even the most demanding
corporate needs with APIs to remotely set up devices, provision settings, define policies, and

define call and SMS filters. And much more.

## Multiple users

messages, and set permissions for guest users.

## WPA2 Enterprise

WLAN gained support for EAP-PEAP, EAP-TLS, and EAP-TTLS authentication methods.

Android device hardware. However, it’s fully independent, and not a derivative or a fork of the
Android codebase.

Sailfish licensees choose if they wish to use the Android compatibility part in the OS, or instead

## The long-awaited Murena Volla Tablet is here!

After many requests, it is finally here. Discover our first privacy oriented tablet, the Murena
Volla tablet!

[**Buy now**][34]

## Freedom starts with privacy

[A screenshot from a Murena Mail account and a screenshot from the Gallery app next to a Murena
smartphone showing the Advanced Privacy app indicating 111131 data leaks blocked]

Every Murena Workspace account comes with 1 GB of free storage space! If you need more space, you
can increase your storage by subscribing to one of our paid plans.

[**View cloud plans and benefits**][35]

## Why use Murena?

It's easier than you think

We're the only viable alternative to Big Techs

Full compatibility with Microsoft 365

Full Android compatibility

No one, not even us, can access your data

Enjoy freedom with privacy

[A person in a black suite from the back surrounded by clouds]

### Our commitment

Every second, people’s online habits and their personal data get collected and turned into highly
detailed profiles of individuals. All this data is harvested by Big Tech without us knowing or
consenting to it.

With our ethical smartphones and cloud, we aim to end this indiscriminate data collection, allowing
people to break free digital surveillance without the hassle of having to tweak on security tools in
their personal devices.

### Complete solution

Our cloud solutions offer everything you need for your daily use, for individuals and organizations.
Murena is the only alternative in the market that truly offers a full ecosystem of privacy-friendly
smartphones and cloud solutions.

Besides our mobile [operating system][36] comes with [Advanced Privacy][37], which keeps you from
being tracked by any corporations, agencies or third party apps with embedded trackers, making /e/OS
your best ally to decrease your digital footprints online.

[Green check mark inside a shield]

### Privacy guaranteed

We’re proud to have earned significant users’ trust across the globe. We are powered by open source
and our software is fully auditable, with every piece of code released publicly, for everyone to
see.

Our privacy claims are supported by reputable institutions, like the Edinburg and [Dublin’s][38]
university, with solid academic studies around privacy.

We’ve also been successfully funded in notable crowdfunding sites like [Kickstarter][39] and
[Crowdcube][40].

[**Create your FREE account now**][41]

with /e/OS. “

“I have been using /e/OS on my phone for a while now. It has everything + #PrivacyByDesign. There

faking my information and even installed privacy focused email- and browser apps. Having full
control over the apps’ permissions made me more sensitive for the matter.”

**Markus**

# You Dream, We Display

여러분이 꿈꾸는 미래, LG디스플레이가 펼쳐갑니다. [더 알아보기][188]

## TV

LG디스플레이의 OLED 기술로 자연의 디테일까지 선명하게 만나보세요. [더 알아보기][189]

## 모니터

강력한 게이밍 퍼포먼스부터 크리에이터를 위한 선명하고 풍부한 색상표현까지. [더 알아보기][190]

## 랩탑

사무 IT 환경에 최적화 된 궁극의 OLED 솔루션. [더 알아보기][191]

## 모바일

### About Us

AGM has kept focus on developing and manufacturing rugged mobile devices for outdoor enthusiasts or
practitioners, and aim to encourage them to conquer their daily challenges calmly, confidently and
safely.

[Learn more][86]

### AGM G3:The Gear for Doers

AGM G3 is your go-to for outdoor trips, featuring an outdoor companion setup with a handy camping
light, 5W 116dB loudspeaker and wireless charging

[EXPLORE][87]

### AGM PAD P2 Active: The Ultimate Rugged Tablet

AGM PAD P2 Active is the first rugged tablet on the market that has a removable protective case.
Remove it and access a regular looking, lighter and thinner tablet that is still waterproof! Like 2
products in 1, rugged when you want.

[EXPLORE][88]

### EXPLORE WITH AGM GLORY

AGM Glory Qualcomm 5G with high technology hardware supporting you to explore your surroundings in
an extreme cold environment, no worries of phone shutting down due to the frozen cold.

## Precision CNC Machining Services

[Our focus on CNC precision machining][73] allows us to offer tailored solutions that meet the
unique requirements of our clients. This advanced machining process utilizes computer-controlled
equipment to ensure tight tolerances and superior finishes. With our experienced machinists and
advanced technology, we are equipped to handle projects ranging from simple components to intricate
assemblies.

[View Our Services][74]

### 5-Axis Machining & Milling

One of the standout capabilities at Astro Machine Works is our [5-axis machining][75] services.
Unlike traditional 3-axis machining, our 5-axis equipment allows for greater flexibility and
precision by enabling cutting on multiple planes. This technology significantly reduces setup times
while increasing the ability to create complex shapes and achieve higher quality surface finishes.
Industries such as [aerospace][76], automotive, and [medical][77] rely on our expertise in [5-axis
machining][78] to produce parts that meet their exact specifications.

### Welding and Fabrication

[Welding and fabrication][79] are integral to our [custom machinery][80] projects. Our skilled team
employs various welding techniques, including MIG, TIG, and orbital welding, to ensure strong,
reliable joints in our fabricated components. We take pride in our fabrication services, which
transform raw materials into finished products, tailored to your specific needs. From small
assemblies to large structures, [our capabilities][81] enable us to tackle projects of any scale.

[Our welding operations][82] are also held to high standards. With [American Welding Society (AWS)
certification][83], our skilled welders produce high-quality welds that ensure the integrity and
durability of every component. Continuous inspection and testing throughout the production process
reinforce our dedication to delivering reliable, high-quality products.

# About BLU Products

BLU Products is a privately owned American company founded in 2009. We have sold over 70 million
devices to date, making it one of the fastest-growing reputable brands in the mobile industry.

Fastest Growing American Mobile Company

## Design.
## Quality. Price.

We pride ourselves in consistently providing users with reliable smartphones at an affordable price
without sacrificing stylish design and superior quality. As a result, we have continued to grow and
expand, cultivating a passionate fanbase with followers worldwide.

## From Miami,
## with Love

We stay true to our roots by tapping into the vibrant culture of our hometown, Miami, FL. Like our
city, we integrate multicultural influences and fashion-forward detailing into our products. This
fresh perspective allows BLU to develop inexpensive, innovative mobile devices. With phones that fit
any budget, our high-quality standards and fashionable designs suit anyone seeking more value
for their money.

Our rapid growth has propelled BLU phones internationally, achieving global success. We have secured
thousands of dealer agents, MVNOs, and large retailers throughout the United States, the Caribbean,
Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

## Certified
## Minority-Owned Business

BLU Products is proud to be a certified Minority-Owned Business. We dedicate ourselves to serving
our community and leading by example to influence positive change. We recognize the benefits of
diversity in the workplace and extend those values to our customers. Businesses that partner with
BLU Products are supporting supplier diversity and inclusion.

In addition, EcoVadis has awarded BLU a Bronze Medal in recognition of our high environmental,
social, and ethical business standards. We've implemented innovative practices for efficient supply
chains and sustainable procurement. At BLU, we always factor local and global impacts into our
decision making, consistently prioritizing sustainability on all fronts.

[National Minority Supplier Development Council]

We take pride in our culture and apply it to everything we do.

We are a part of ASBIS Group

A leading IT company specializing in value-added distribution and development of IT, IoT, and
Robotic products, solutions, and services to the markets of Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.

The synergy with other ASBIS businesses enables us to leverage our commitment to sustainability.

Our Trade-In service can drive a 20% increase in sales by allowing customers to trade in old devices
as payment toward new ones.

We offer a plug-and-play Trade-In solution with ongoing support and a full suite of additional
services to ensure a smooth in-store and online experience.

More about Trade-in ][24] [

Seeking a trustworthy supplier or buyer of high-quality used devices? Breezy is your trusted partner

Our buyback program allows you to sell old devices for credit toward new ones or based on your

We partner with companies of any size, including resellers, to provide flexible, sustainable
solutions for device turnover.

Our expertly restored devices undergo rigorous testing on 55 quality indicators and come with a
warranty of up to 24 months.

* Trade in your old phone hassle-free.

* Warranty up to 24 months

Creatons is an electronics manufacturing solution provider, based in Delhi NCR, India, specializing
in custom electronic devices and accessories. Our dedication towards R&D and continual advancement
in terms of latest technologies, has made us a renowned name in the domain of Electronics
Manufacturing Services (EMS).

### Products & Services

Creatons offers its customers 360-degree services.

If you are looking for solutions to all your requirements in the domain of Electronics
Manufacturing, then we are a complete package to your needs. We provide end-to-end services starting
from procurement, design and manufacturing to multi-level quality checks to deliver to notch
products. We also offer PCB Assembly Services for varous products.

### **WHY US?**

**Integrity**

Creatons is built on high level “integrity” – it is the foundation of what we do. Our defining
characters have been team work & accountability, leading our manufacturing relationships to a great
success.

**Expertise**

Creatons believes in continuous learning. We share valuable inputs, gained through experience and
skill, to our clients to ensure that they get the best possible solution to their requirements.

**Transparency**

Our managing team allows for clear communication with our clients and vendors to avoid anything that
might get lost in translation. Being transparent always paves off to build trust among businesses.

**Support**

Creatons offers unparalleled services to always support our clients in every way possible. The team
doesn’t shy away from going the extra mile to make our customers happy.

**Punctuality**

We are located in Delhi NCR, India, the capital of the world’s fastest growing economy. Timely
deliveries, without compromising on quality has been one of our strong points.

**Quality**

Quality control is an integral part of every step of our production plan. We continuously analyse
and makes improvements to our QC procedures to ensure grade-A deliveries always.

# UP DigiShakti Portal - Student Login, Registration & E-KYC

The Uttar Pradesh government has launched the UP DigiShakti Portal to facilitate the distribution of
tablets and smartphones to eligible students in the state. Through this portal, students can
complete their e-KYC verification, check their eligibility status, and access information about
tablet/smartphone distribution.

This portal streamlines the verification process through MeriPehchaan e-KYC and ensures eligible
students receive their devices efficiently.

[Student Login][6] [Status Check][7] [e-KYC Verification][8] [Tablet/Smartphone List][9]
💡
Important Notice: Only use the official website (https://digishakti.up.gov.in/) to keep your
information secure. Do not share your Aadhaar details, enrollment number, or personal information on
any fake/malicious websites.

## UP DigiShakti Portal Student Login

To access the UP DigiShakti Portal for student verification and tablet/smartphone distribution,
follow this process:
1. First, visit the official UP DigiShakti Portal website at: [https://digishakti.up.gov.in/][10]
2. Click on the "e-KYC through MeriPehchaan Portal" button on the website's homepage.
3. Select your University/Board/Society/Council and College/Institution from the dropdown menus.
4. Enter your enrollment number and the captcha code displayed on screen.
5. Click on the "Search" button to proceed.

Before proceeding with the verification, please ensure the following:
* Use only the official DigiShakti website (https://digishakti.up.gov.in/)
* Have your enrollment number ready
* Ensure your Aadhaar details are correct and match with your educational records
* Have access to your Aadhaar-linked mobile number for OTP verification

## UP DigiShakti Portal e-KYC Verification Process

To complete the e-KYC verification on DigiShakti Portal using MeriPehchaan, follow these steps:

### Step 1: Access the DigiShakti Website

Visit the official UP DigiShakti Portal at [https://digishakti.up.gov.in/][11]

[UP DigiShakti Portal Homepage]

### Step 2: Enter Student Details

Select your University/Board/Society/Council, College/Institution, enter your enrollment number and
captcha, then click "Search" button.

[Student Details Entry]

### Step 3: Verify Student Information

Your details will be displayed on screen. If your Aadhaar e-KYC status shows "Pending", click on
"Verify through the Login using e-Pramaan MeriPehchaan" button.

[e-KYC Verification Button]

### Step 4: MeriPehchaan Sign-Up/Sign-In

You'll be redirected to the MeriPehchaan portal. If you're a new user, click on "New user? Sign up
for MeriPehchaan". If you're an existing user, sign in with your credentials.

[MeriPehchaan Login]

### Step 5: New User Registration (For new users only)

Enter your mobile number and verify it using OTP. Fill in your personal details exactly as they
appear on your Aadhaar card:

[MeriPehchaan Registration]
* Full name (as per Aadhaar)
* Date of birth (as per Aadhaar)
* Gender (as per Aadhaar)
* Create username and password
* Accept terms and conditions

### Step 6: Aadhaar e-KYC

Complete the Aadhaar e-KYC verification:

[Aadhaar e-KYC]
* Enter your Aadhaar number
* Choose OTP medium (mobile or email)
* Click on "verify through eKYC" button
* Enter the OTP received on your Aadhaar-linked mobile/email
[Enter OTP]

### Step 7: Verification Complete

Upon successful verification, you'll see a success message and be redirected back to the DigiShakti
portal.

[Success Message]

### 🔎 Requirements for Verification:
* Aadhaar card with correct details (name, DOB, gender)
* Access to Aadhaar-linked mobile or email for OTP
* Enrollment number from your educational institution
* Your institution must have uploaded your correct details to the portal
* Your data must match between institutional records and Aadhaar

💡
Note: If your verification fails due to mismatches between your institution's records and Aadhaar
details, contact your Institution Nodal Officer to correct the information. After corrections,
you'll need to go through the verification process again.

## UP DigiShakti Portal Status Check

To check the status of your application and e-KYC verification on the DigiShakti Portal, follow
these steps:
1. **Access the DigiShakti Portal**
   Visit the official website at https://digishakti.up.gov.in/
2. **Enter Your Details**
   Select your University/Board/Society/Council, College/Institution, enter enrollment number and
   captcha.
3. **Check Your Status**
   Your verification status will be displayed on screen:
   * **Pending**: You need to complete e-KYC verification
   * **Verified**: Your e-KYC has been successfully verified
   * **Failed**: There's a mismatch between your institution data and Aadhaar data
   * **Under Process**: Your data is pending for Department Lock

   Visit the official website at https://digishakti.up.gov.in/
2. **Enter Your Details**
   Select your University/Board/Society/Council, College/Institution, enter enrollment number and
   captcha.
3. **Check Your Status**
   Your verification status will be displayed on screen:
   * **Pending**: You need to complete e-KYC verification
   * **Verified**: Your e-KYC has been successfully verified
   * **Failed**: There's a mismatch between your institution data and Aadhaar data
   * **Under Process**: Your data is pending for Department Lock
4. **In Case of Failed Status**
   Contact your Institution Nodal Officer to edit the mismatched details on the portal, or update
   your Aadhaar information if needed.
5. **After Corrections**
   Your data will go through the authentication process again: verification by institution, approval
   by University, and locking by Department.
6. **Retry Verification**
   After corrections, your data will become available again for Aadhaar verification by you.

## UP DigiShakti Portal Tablet/Smartphone List

To check the tablet/smartphone distribution list and download relevant information:
1. **Visit the Official Website**
   Go to the official UP DigiShakti Portal website at [https://digishakti.up.gov.in/][12]
2. **Navigate to Distribution List**
   Look for the section related to tablet/smartphone distribution lists or beneficiary lists.
3. **Search Your Details**
   Enter your institution details, district, or other search parameters to filter the list.
4. **Download PDF List**
   Once you locate your relevant distribution list, you can download it in PDF format for future
   reference.
5. **Distribution Process**
   * After verification, your institution will notify you about the device collection process
   * You may need to bring your ID proof and enrollment details during collection
   * Distribution typically happens at your educational institution or designated centers

The UP DigiShakti Portal is an initiative by the Uttar Pradesh government to distribute tablets and

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.

Join us in redefining nutrition and medicine for current and future generations.

After many requests, it is finally here. Discover our first privacy oriented tablet, the Murena
Volla tablet!

[**Buy now**][34]

## Freedom starts with privacy

[A screenshot from a Murena Mail account and a screenshot from the Gallery app next to a Murena
smartphone showing the Advanced Privacy app indicating 111131 data leaks blocked]

Every Murena Workspace account comes with 1 GB of free storage space! If you need more space, you
can increase your storage by subscribing to one of our paid plans.

[**View cloud plans and benefits**][35]

## Why use Murena?

It's easier than you think

We're the only viable alternative to Big Techs

Full compatibility with Microsoft 365

Full Android compatibility

No one, not even us, can access your data

Enjoy freedom with privacy

[A person in a black suite from the back surrounded by clouds]

### Our commitment

Every second, people’s online habits and their personal data get collected and turned into highly
detailed profiles of individuals. All this data is harvested by Big Tech without us knowing or
consenting to it.

With our ethical smartphones and cloud, we aim to end this indiscriminate data collection, allowing
people to break free digital surveillance without the hassle of having to tweak on security tools in
their personal devices.

### Complete solution

Our cloud solutions offer everything you need for your daily use, for individuals and organizations.
Murena is the only alternative in the market that truly offers a full ecosystem of privacy-friendly
smartphones and cloud solutions.

Besides our mobile [operating system][36] comes with [Advanced Privacy][37], which keeps you from
being tracked by any corporations, agencies or third party apps with embedded trackers, making /e/OS
your best ally to decrease your digital footprints online.

[Green check mark inside a shield]

### Privacy guaranteed

We’re proud to have earned significant users’ trust across the globe. We are powered by open source
and our software is fully auditable, with every piece of code released publicly, for everyone to
see.

Our privacy claims are supported by reputable institutions, like the Edinburg and [Dublin’s][38]
university, with solid academic studies around privacy.

We’ve also been successfully funded in notable crowdfunding sites like [Kickstarter][39] and
[Crowdcube][40].

[**Create your FREE account now**][41]

with /e/OS. “

faking my information and even installed privacy focused email- and browser apps. Having full
control over the apps’ permissions made me more sensitive for the matter.”

**Markus**

## The Complete Guide to Understanding Smartphone Specifications in 2026

Everything you need to know before buying your next phone

In an era where smartphones have become indispensable companions in our daily lives, understanding
their specifications is more important than ever. Whether you are a tech enthusiast looking for the
latest cutting-edge features or a casual user seeking a reliable device for everyday tasks, knowing
what each specification means can make the difference between a satisfying purchase and buyer's
remorse. At **PhoneSpecs**, we provide comprehensive, up-to-date specifications for thousands of
mobile phones, helping you make informed decisions with confidence.

### Processor and Performance: The Heart of Your Phone

The processor, often referred to as the chipset or SoC (System on Chip), is the brain of any
smartphone. Modern processors like the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, Apple A18 Pro, and MediaTek
Dimensity 9300 deliver desktop-class performance in the palm of your hand. When evaluating a
processor, pay attention to the manufacturing process (measured in nanometers), the number of CPU
cores, GPU capability, and AI processing power. A more efficient processor not only delivers better
performance but also contributes to improved battery life and reduced heat generation during
intensive tasks like gaming or video editing.

### Display Technology: Your Window to the Digital World

The display is arguably the most important component of a smartphone since it is the primary way you
interact with your device. Today's smartphones offer a variety of display technologies, each with
distinct advantages. AMOLED and OLED panels deliver vibrant colors, deep blacks, and excellent
contrast ratios, while LTPO technology enables variable refresh rates from 1Hz to 120Hz or even
240Hz, ensuring both smooth scrolling and power efficiency. Key specifications to consider include
resolution (Full HD+ being the minimum standard for crisp visuals), peak brightness (important for
outdoor visibility), and HDR support for enhanced media consumption.

### Camera Systems: Capturing Life in Stunning Detail

Modern smartphone camera systems have evolved into sophisticated multi-lens setups that rival
dedicated cameras. A typical flagship phone now features a primary wide-angle lens, an ultrawide
lens, and a telephoto lens, each serving a specific purpose. Beyond megapixel counts, factors like
sensor size, pixel size, optical image stabilization (OIS), and computational photography
capabilities play crucial roles in image quality. Features such as Night Mode, Portrait Mode with
depth sensing, and 8K video recording have become standard in premium devices.

### Battery and Charging: Keeping You Connected All Day

Battery life remains one of the most critical factors in smartphone selection. Battery capacity,
measured in milliampere-hours (mAh), provides a baseline indicator, but actual battery life depends

## The Complete Guide to Understanding Smartphone Specifications in 2026

Everything you need to know before buying your next phone

In an era where smartphones have become indispensable companions in our daily lives, understanding
their specifications is more important than ever. Whether you are a tech enthusiast looking for the
latest cutting-edge features or a casual user seeking a reliable device for everyday tasks, knowing
what each specification means can make the difference between a satisfying purchase and buyer's
remorse. At **PhoneSpecs**, we provide comprehensive, up-to-date specifications for thousands of
mobile phones, helping you make informed decisions with confidence.

### Processor and Performance: The Heart of Your Phone

The processor, often referred to as the chipset or SoC (System on Chip), is the brain of any
smartphone. Modern processors like the Qualcomm Snapdragon 8 Gen 3, Apple A18 Pro, and MediaTek
Dimensity 9300 deliver desktop-class performance in the palm of your hand. When evaluating a
processor, pay attention to the manufacturing process (measured in nanometers), the number of CPU
cores, GPU capability, and AI processing power. A more efficient processor not only delivers better
performance but also contributes to improved battery life and reduced heat generation during
intensive tasks like gaming or video editing.

### Display Technology: Your Window to the Digital World

The display is arguably the most important component of a smartphone since it is the primary way you
interact with your device. Today's smartphones offer a variety of display technologies, each with
distinct advantages. AMOLED and OLED panels deliver vibrant colors, deep blacks, and excellent
contrast ratios, while LTPO technology enables variable refresh rates from 1Hz to 120Hz or even
240Hz, ensuring both smooth scrolling and power efficiency. Key specifications to consider include
resolution (Full HD+ being the minimum standard for crisp visuals), peak brightness (important for
outdoor visibility), and HDR support for enhanced media consumption.

### Camera Systems: Capturing Life in Stunning Detail

Modern smartphone camera systems have evolved into sophisticated multi-lens setups that rival
dedicated cameras. A typical flagship phone now features a primary wide-angle lens, an ultrawide
lens, and a telephoto lens, each serving a specific purpose. Beyond megapixel counts, factors like
sensor size, pixel size, optical image stabilization (OIS), and computational photography
capabilities play crucial roles in image quality. Features such as Night Mode, Portrait Mode with
depth sensing, and 8K video recording have become standard in premium devices.

### Battery and Charging: Keeping You Connected All Day

Battery life remains one of the most critical factors in smartphone selection. Battery capacity,
measured in milliampere-hours (mAh), provides a baseline indicator, but actual battery life depends
heavily on display technology, processor efficiency, and software optimization. Most modern
smartphones offer between 4,500mAh and 6,000mAh batteries. Equally important is charging speed —
technologies like 100W fast charging can fully charge a device in under 30 minutes, while wireless
charging and reverse wireless charging add convenience.

### Memory and Storage: Room for Everything

RAM (Random Access Memory) directly impacts multitasking performance, with flagship devices now
offering 12GB to 24GB of RAM for seamless app switching and demanding workloads. Internal storage
options range from 128GB to 1TB, with UFS 4.0 technology providing blazing-fast read and write
speeds. While some devices still support microSD card expansion, the industry trend is moving toward
high-capacity built-in storage combined with cloud services for flexible data management.

### Connectivity and 5G: Staying Connected Everywhere

Modern connectivity features extend far beyond basic cellular and Wi-Fi. 5G support has become
standard even in mid-range devices, offering significantly faster download speeds and lower latency.
Wi-Fi 7 brings multi-link operation for improved throughput and reliability, while Bluetooth 5.4
ensures stable connections with wireless accessories. NFC enables contactless payments, and
satellite connectivity is emerging as a safety feature in remote areas.

### Why Use PhoneSpecs for Phone Specifications?

PhoneSpecs stands as your trusted companion in the smartphone selection process. Our database is
continuously updated with the latest device releases, ensuring you always have access to current and
accurate information. We provide detailed specifications in an easy-to-read format, enabling quick
comparisons between different models. Whether you are researching the latest Samsung Galaxy, Apple
iPhone, Xiaomi, OPPO, or any other brand, our platform offers a comprehensive overview of every
device's capabilities, helping you find the perfect phone that matches your needs and budget.

Sailfish OS is a Linux-based European alternative to dominating mobile operating systems, and the
only mobile OS offering an exclusive licensing model for local implementations.

On the market since 2013 Sailfish OS is the privacy respecting choice for mobile solutions. With
Sailfish OS you can also run Android™ apps with our dedicated AppSupport solution.

Sailfish OS is managed and developed by Finnish company [Jolla][9].

[Try and buy now!][10]

##### Business & partnership inquiries: [partners@jolla.com][11]


# Reliable corporate platform

Sailfish OS is a secure and privacy respecting mobile operating system optimized to run on
smartphones and tablets, and also easily adaptable to all kinds of embedded devices and use cases.
With the operating system enablers Sailfish OS can be adapted to support different ecosystem
projects, be it private corporate solutions or public sector governmental deployments.

[Read more ›][12]

# Security

Sailfish OS has a host of modern security functionalities developed specifically for corporate and
governmental environments. In Sailfish OS user data is fully encrypted and apps are protected by
Firejail sandboxing. Connectivity is behind a firewall and protected with in-built support for VPNs,
and automatic backups always secure your data. Core OS services are sandboxed using systemd, and the
whole system can be managed on the OS level with the full-scale MDM capability.

[Read more >][13]

together with our customers and developer community.

[Sailfish OS forum][15] is there to support the active developer community.

[Read more ›][16]

# at the core

The main design principles of Sailfish OS have always included a seamless user experience combined
with unique and clean Scandinavian design.

Apps are a natural part of a mobile UX. With Sailfish OS you can run beautiful gesture-based native
apps powered by Qt framework or opt-in to run your favourite [Android apps][17] securely executed in
an isolated sandbox.

## User Interface

Sailfish OS has been built ground-up to scale to different form factors and input styles. Sub-pixel
scaling support means Sailfish OS works beautifully on any display size, from small smartwatches to
smart TVs.

Furthermore, fully customizable preloaded content helps you tailor the OS to your needs: wallpapers,
tones, photos, videos, bookmarks, even small details like default email signatures, Bluetooth and
hotspot names can all be easily rebranded. The centralized style asset makes it easy to further
customize the experience with layouts, icons, fonts and effects.

## Dedicated device mode

Sailfish OS is smart at heart, but also a great companion for single-purpose devices designed to
handle a few functions really well.

Focus on creating a great product experience, and let Sailfish OS worry about the nitty-gritty
technical details like connectivity, security, user management, over-the-air updates, and other OS
services.

# World-class mobile device management for corporations

Mobile device management (MDM) support in Sailfish OS is designed to meet even the most demanding
corporate needs with APIs to remotely set up devices, provision settings, define policies, and
manage installed software. Monitor data, call, and SMS statistics, publish remote notifications, and
define call and SMS filters. And much more.

Provision certificates, accounts, connectivity configurations, and other device settings for your

Perform OS updates and manage installed apps remotely.

## Device locking

Remotely lock or securely wipe data from compromised devices.

## Multiple users

Remotely manage who can access the device, add and remove users, control who can call and send
messages, and set permissions for guest users.

[Read more ›][29]

## WPA2 Enterprise

WLAN gained support for EAP-PEAP, EAP-TLS, and EAP-TTLS authentication methods.

Android device hardware. However, it’s fully independent, and not a derivative or a fork of the
Android codebase.

[Our focus on CNC precision machining][73] allows us to offer tailored solutions that meet the
unique requirements of our clients. This advanced machining process utilizes computer-controlled
equipment to ensure tight tolerances and superior finishes. With our experienced machinists and
advanced technology, we are equipped to handle projects ranging from simple components to intricate
assemblies.

[View Our Services][74]

### 5-Axis Machining & Milling

One of the standout capabilities at Astro Machine Works is our [5-axis machining][75] services.
Unlike traditional 3-axis machining, our 5-axis equipment allows for greater flexibility and
precision by enabling cutting on multiple planes. This technology significantly reduces setup times
while increasing the ability to create complex shapes and achieve higher quality surface finishes.
Industries such as [aerospace][76], automotive, and [medical][77] rely on our expertise in [5-axis
machining][78] to produce parts that meet their exact specifications.

### Welding and Fabrication

[Welding and fabrication][79] are integral to our [custom machinery][80] projects. Our skilled team
employs various welding techniques, including MIG, TIG, and orbital welding, to ensure strong,
reliable joints in our fabricated components. We take pride in our fabrication services, which
transform raw materials into finished products, tailored to your specific needs. From small
assemblies to large structures, [our capabilities][81] enable us to tackle projects of any scale.

[Our welding operations][82] are also held to high standards. With [American Welding Society (AWS)
certification][83], our skilled welders produce high-quality welds that ensure the integrity and
durability of every component. Continuous inspection and testing throughout the production process
reinforce our dedication to delivering reliable, high-quality products.

Creatons is an electronics manufacturing solution provider, based in Delhi NCR, India, specializing
in custom electronic devices and accessories. Our dedication towards R&D and continual advancement
in terms of latest technologies, has made us a renowned name in the domain of Electronics
Manufacturing Services (EMS).

### Products & Services

Creatons offers its customers 360-degree services.

If you are looking for solutions to all your requirements in the domain of Electronics
Manufacturing, then we are a complete package to your needs. We provide end-to-end services starting
from procurement, design and manufacturing to multi-level quality checks to deliver to notch
products. We also offer PCB Assembly Services for varous products.

### **WHY US?**

**Integrity**

Creatons is built on high level “integrity” – it is the foundation of what we do. Our defining
characters have been team work & accountability, leading our manufacturing relationships to a great
success.

**Expertise**

Creatons believes in continuous learning. We share valuable inputs, gained through experience and
skill, to our clients to ensure that they get the best possible solution to their requirements.

**Transparency**

Our managing team allows for clear communication with our clients and vendors to avoid anything that
might get lost in translation. Being transparent always paves off to build trust among businesses.

**Support**

Creatons offers unparalleled services to always support our clients in every way possible. The team
doesn’t shy away from going the extra mile to make our customers happy.

**Punctuality**

We are located in Delhi NCR, India, the capital of the world’s fastest growing economy. Timely
deliveries, without compromising on quality has been one of our strong points.

**Quality**

Quality control is an integral part of every step of our production plan. We continuously analyse
and makes improvements to our QC procedures to ensure grade-A deliveries always.

vaccines, and regenerative medicine.

[ JOURNEY WITH US ][67]

Esco Aster provides cell-based products and derivatives for clinical and functional nutrition. These
include cell-based meats, proteins, fatty acids, collagen, and other high-value ingredients such as
bird’s nest, deer antler, mitochondria, and milk-/plant-derived extracellular vesicles for
nutraceuticals and supplements.

# About Esco Aster

Esco Aster is a vertically integrated bioinnovation venture accelerator delivering end-to-end
“idea-to-exit” contract solutions—from consultancy and research to CMC development, manufacturing,
testing, clinical development, business development, strategic capital and enterprise support.

We provide phase-appropriate capabilities that scale with our collaborators, sponsors, and partners
– from early development through GLP Tox, clinical, pilot, demonstration as a CRDMO / CDMO and full
commercial production (CMO).

Founded by scientists, we empower fellow innovators to translate benchwork and intellectual property
into real-world impact.

Through our platforms, we serve the broader bio-based deep tech bioeconomy—spanning life-saving
diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, dermatology, dermocosmetics/cosmeceuticals, medical aesthetics/
injectables/coatings, nutraceuticals, and cellular agriculture — delivering high-yield,
cost-effective solutions aligned with self-sufficiency and health technology assessment frameworks.

Our patented, best-in-class manufacturing platforms simplify complexity, enabling reliable, linearly
scalable outcomes. Our technologies have been successfully deployed in multiple commercial human and
animal vaccines, dermocosmetics, as well as in cell-based nutrition and clinical-grade stem cells
and exosomes.

We continuously invest in advancing manufacturing science to address unmet clinical needs, unlocking
bottlenecks across existing and emerging modalities from concept to cure.

Together with our venture ecosystem, we champion an interconnected One World. One Health
approach—bringing innovation to life for people, planet and profit.
